description: Render a hand-authored ASCII Grid (inline text or a .grid file, exactly one) into PNG bytes and/or the editable .mcpx source, with an optional batch applied after parsing. For pixel-level authorship without per-pixel tool calls.

gridPath.description: Standalone ASCII Grid file path. Exactly one of gridPath and gridText is required.

gridText.description: Inline ASCII Grid document text. Exactly one of gridPath and gridText is required.

operations.description: Optional batch operations JSON text applied after the grid is parsed.

outputMcpxPath.description: Explicit .mcpx output path. When omitted, the .mcpx text is embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

outputPngPath.description: Explicit PNG output path. When omitted, the PNG bytes are embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

name: render_pixel_asset
